paper_metadata.title: Viscoplastic phase field simulation of microstructural evolutions under complex loadings in Ni-base superalloys

evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: An elasto-viscoplastic phase field model is proposed to study the microstructural evolutions under mechanical loadings in a Ni-base superalloy single crystal.
